name: Seitan
siboNotes: Contains concentrated wheat fructans and should be avoided during SIBO treatment phases. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Check ingredient lists as commercial seitan may contain onion and garlic
Homemade versions allow better control over FODMAP ingredients
Some brands use soy sauce which may add additional FODMAPs
Consider portion size carefully as fructan content is concentrated
